title: PN: Prime number theorems formalized in Lean (Sylvester–Schur, prime gaps, Jacobsthal)
description: Formal, machine-checked proofs in Lean 4 / Mathlib: (1) classical prime-number theorems — Sylvester–Schur (complete, 0 'sorry', 0 errors), unboundedness of prime gaps, Jacobsthal function values (j(2310) = 14); (2) the mathematically verified core of an original quantitative model of centriole geometric aging (Ornstein–Uhlenbeck with maternal transmission, alpha ≈ 0.97): closed forms, variance accumulation, strict monotonicity, finite equilibria (CentrioleAging.lean).
